title: Production of High-Purity Cell Suspensions from Human Precision Cut Lung Slices for Single-Cell RNA Sequencing
author: Michael Peasley

steps.title: Prepare Filtered Media
steps.instruction: Combine the following reagents in the top chamber of a bottle-top vacuum filter: 500 mL DMEM high glucose (4.5g/L) + L-Glutamine, 50 mL Heat-inactivated FBS, 5 mL of 100x Non-Essential Amino Acids, 5 mL Sodium Pyruvate 100nM, 7.5 mL 1M HEPES Buffer, 5 mL of 10,000u/mL Penicillin/Streptavidin, 500 µL (125ug) Amphotericin B, and 800 µL (40ug) Gentamicin. Filter using vacuum into the bottom chamber, aliquot, and store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare PCLS for Initial Wash
steps.instruction: Prepare a warm water bath with autoclaved diH2O at 37°C. Place PCLS vials into the bath, gently swirling without submerging the cap until only small ice crystals remain (do not thaw completely).

steps.title: Transfer and Wash PCLS
steps.instruction: In a biosafety cabinet, swiftly decant the vial over a 6-well transwell membrane. If the slice does not fall out, rinse the vial with PBS or use sterile flat head forceps to gently place and uncurl the slice so it lies flat on the membrane.

substeps.instruction: Gently dispense 500 µL of DPBS with Ca2+/Mg2+ onto the slice.
Gently swirl the plate and remove the DPBS without disturbing the slice.
Repeat the wash step.

steps.title: Incubate PCLS (Day One)
steps.instruction: Dispense 800 µL of PLCS-TW media into the bottom chamber of the transwell so it contacts but does not submerge the PCLS. Label wells accordingly.

substeps.instruction: Dispense 800 µL of PLCS-TW media into any unused wells to prevent drying.
Place the plate in an incubator at 37°C with 5% CO2.

steps.title: Refresh Media (Day Two)
steps.instruction: Remove the transwell plate from the incubator to the biosafety cabinet and dispense 800 µL of fresh PCLS-TW media into the bottom chamber of each well.

steps.title: Prepare Equipment and Dissociation Cocktail
steps.instruction: Set the incubator to 37°C and the centrifuge to 4°C. Prepare the dissociation cocktail using the following components:

substeps.instruction: Prepare Digestion Buffer: 1 L divalent cation free DPBS + 10mL 1M HEPES-NaOH (pH 7.4) + 8.77g NaCl + 0.37g KCl + 0.1g MgCl2 + 0.2g CaCl2.

For 10 mL of dissociation cocktail in a 15 mL conical tube, combine: 10 mL Digestion Buffer, 20 mg Collagenase type A (final 2mg/ml), 200 µL Dispase II (1 mg/mL) (final 1mg/ml), 5 mg Elastase (final 0.5mg/mL), and 20 mg DNase (final 2mg/mL).

steps.title: Tissue Dissociation
steps.instruction: Dispense 500 µL of dissociation cocktail into labeled 5mL culture tubes (one per slice) and place each PCLS into a tube.

substeps.instruction: Place tubes on an orbital shaker in a 37°C incubator.
Incubate and shake at 1000 rpm, 37 °C, for 40 minutes.

steps.title: Cell Recovery and Straining
steps.instruction: After incubation, add 500 µL DPBS++ to each tube and pour the contents into a 70uM cell strainer placed on top of a well.

substeps.instruction: Rinse tubes with an additional 500 µL of DPBS++ to maximize recovery.
Push tissue through the strainer using the plunger end of a 3mL syringe, swirling in circular motions 5-10 times.
Add another 500 µL of DPBS++ and push any remaining tissue through the strainer.
Collect strained cells using a pipette and place in a 15mL tube.

steps.title: Initial Cell Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the 15mL tube at 1000 x g, 4 °C, for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Debris Removal
steps.instruction: Carefully resuspend the cell suspension with 6200 µL of cold DPBS++ and transfer to a 15mL tube (do not vortex).

substeps.instruction: Add 1800 µL of cold Debris Removal Solution.
Mix well by pipetting slowly up and down 10 times using a 2 mL pipette.
Tilt the tube and very slowly overlay with 4 mL of cold DPBS++ to ensure the PBS/D-PBS phase overlays the cell suspension without mixing.
Centrifuge at 3000 x g, 4 °C, for 10 minutes with full acceleration and full brake.

steps.title: Final Purification and Resuspension
steps.instruction: Vacuum aspirate and discard the top two phases (approximately 4mL).

substeps.instruction: Add cold DPBS++ to a final volume of 15 mL.
Gently invert the tube three times to mix (do not vortex).
Centrifuge at 1000 x g, 4 °C, for 10 minutes with full acceleration and full brakes.
Aspirate supernatant completely without disturbing the pellet.
Carefully resuspend cells by adding 175 µL of cold DPBS++, pipetting slowly up and down (do not vortex).
Place the final suspension on ice.

steps.title: Post-Procedure Cleanup
steps.instruction: Return the transwell plate to the incubator at 37°C with 5% CO2, aspirate the media from the bottom chamber of each well, and discard.
